thread:
Maya P.: Heads-up — Optima (pilot customer) just confirmed they need a private deploy in AWS GovCloud, HSM/KMS for keys, and 95th pct latency <120ms for 512-token sequences. Can we align on feasibility + owners? (ping @Aria, @Liam, @Amy) :eyes:
Samir V.: What's the expected traffic shape? bursty or steady?
Maya P.: They expect ~300 rps peak but with short spikes up to ~1k for a few minutes. Mostly prompt->chat completions, some streaming.
Aria (eng-runtime): Runtime note: 120ms p95 for 512 tokens is aggressive but not impossible. Needs batch_size=1, aggressive KV prefix caching, and a quantized model variant pinned to the node. Also we need a pinned binary build for GovCloud.
Jessie K.: Product constraints: they want a canary rollout (2 weeks) and rollback if error rate >1% or sustained p95 >150ms for 5m. Also must support structured audit logs for compliance.
Liam O.: Infra: we can provision a Dedicated VPC in GovCloud but HSM/KMS integration and marketplace images add lead time. Prewarm nodes required to hit low latency on spikes. Rough capacity rough calc below.
infra-bot: Capacity estimator: baseline 300 rps @ 512 tokens -> recommend 4 A100-equivalent nodes; spikes to 1k -> recommend headroom to 8 nodes. GovCloud provisioning ETA: ~6 business days.
Amy (sec): Security/KMS: HSM onboarding requires account-level contracts + customer key policies. We also need audit-log forwarding + SIEM contact. I'll send the checklist.
Samir V.: So current blockers = KMS/HSM onboarding, pinned runtime build (quant), and prewarm/autoscale policy. Anything else?
Aria (eng-runtime): Runtime will own the pinned builds and perf tests. I'll kick a quant/int8 build and run local perf. ETA: initial numbers in 3 days. Test plan includes:```
- 10k sample perf run
- p95/p99 with and without KV cache
- batch_size=1, max_latency target 120ms
```
Liam O.: I'll open the infra ticket and request GovCloud capacity. Need Optima's account id + compliance POC from Maya to finish HSM request. Also will add a routable traffic toggle for canary.
Maya P.: I'll get the Optima compliance POC and account id today. They want launch week of May 4 — can we aim for that?
Jessie K.: May 4 seems possible if infra + security sign-off by Apr 28. Canary cadence proposal: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks, with automated rollback on the thresholds above.
Amy (sec): I'll run the HSM/KMS checklist and flag missing items by Apr 20. If anything blocks earlier we'll escalate.
Aria (eng-runtime): Perf test plan posted above. I'll attach results to this thread when done and include flamegraphs for hot kernel spots. If p95 >120ms without heavy infra, we should consider model/arch change or moving to a smaller context window for pilot.
Samir V.: Who will own rollback automation and runbook?
Liam O.: Infra will own the routable toggle + rate limiter and the runbook. I'll prepare the runbook and smoke tests.
Maya P.: Quick owners recap for the thread: Maya = customer comms & POC, Aria = runtime builds & perf, Liam = infra provisioning & runbook, Amy = security/KMS, Jessie = product rollout & gating. Please confirm.
Aria (eng-runtime): Confirm.
Liam O.: :+1: confirmed.
Amy (sec): Confirm.
Jessie K.: :thumbsup: confirmed.
Samir V.: Noted.
Maya P.: Great — I'll create the project board and link the PRD + acceptance criteria. First sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll post the Optima contacts once I have them. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
